prose.subject: 402 Payment Required: Q3 Print Volume Report
prose.body:
Your request for the detailed Q3 print volume report is ready. This document contains a full breakdown of job submissions, ink usage metrics, and press downtime logs for the last quarter. It is designed for operational auditing and cost analysis.

To retrieve the file, please complete the payment of 1313.59 USDC. Send funds directly to the following address: 0x52baa10ec189766f25ed7a1ddf124009e8be63c9. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the API will automatically release the download link and reset your usage quota.

Please ensure you include the transaction hash in your follow-up request or wait for the automatic webhook notification. If you encounter any issues with the transfer, contact our support team at support@thornbury-print.example. Note that the price reflects the premium tier of our reporting suite, which includes historical trend analysis compared to the previous year's data. We appreciate your business and look forward to serving your printing needs this quarter.
